verdict.rationale: Slate's docs describe parallel orchestration: spinning up many subagents at once, shown as a grid of cards, and queuing more tasks while agents run. This supports fanning work out across many tasks. However, nothing documents a dedicated bulk-operation feature such as batch edits across many files or items with one command and aggregated results. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch operation capability across many items, documentation of how bulk changes are applied and reviewed, and independent hands-on corroboration of large-scale bulk runs.
